claims.text: A 14-year-old male presented to the ophthalmology outpatient department with severe bilateral visual impairment, particularly under bright light. Slit-lamp examination showed a clear anterior chamber, a cataractous lens nucleus and characteristic powdery opacities, leading to a diagnosis of bilateral cataracta pulverulenta without ectopia lentis.
